meta.name: competitive-research
meta.description: Produce a sourced competitive matrix for a focused research question

copy.tagline: 生成带来源的竞品对比矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速了解某个市场或产品的竞争格局。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a sourced competitive matrix for a focused research question.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the competitive landscape of a market or product.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你做竞争分析：先问你要研究什么、看哪些对手，然后上网查资料，最后生成一张对比表格和总结报告，存在 research/ 文件夹里。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一个研究主题（如“竞品怎么做新手引导”）或一个研究提示文件路径时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下竞品怎么做新手引导。
say.note: Claude 会询问具体对手和问题，然后生成对比表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you do competitive research: it asks what to study and which competitors to look at, then searches the web, produces a comparison table and a summary report, and saves it in the research/ folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give Claude a research topic (e.g., "how competitors handle first-time user onboarding") or a path to a research-prompt file.

say_en.text: Analyze how competitors handle first-time user onboarding.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for specifics and generate a comparison table.

say_en.text: Use this file for competitive research: samples/sample-competitor-prompt.md
say_en.note: Claude reads the research prompt from the file and executes.
